verdict: The accepted version mainly rebuilds the orbital-dispersion analysis: a general NN/NNN dispersion fit, revised model parameters (Delta 4.4, U 6.5, JH 1.2 eV) and a new Hund's-exchange mechanism for NN orbiton hopping, worked out by a theorist added as coauthor. The magnetic part is softened: J_perp for PrNiO2 is fixed with a 0-10 meV range and '3D order' becomes '3D correlations'. New paragraphs on strain, the 0.7 eV peak and the absence of charge order, plus a full SI and data link, point to referee requests. The damping comparison, sample characterization and most minor items are untouched.

inferred_requests.title: Fit the orbital dispersion with the correct NN and NNN forms
inferred_requests.text: The cos kx cos ky law describes NNN hopping, so it cannot support NN propagation in PrNiO2; refit with a general dispersion that separates NN and NNN terms and reconcile the bandwidths.

inferred_requests.title: Explain why NN orbiton hopping survives the string effect in PrNiO2
inferred_requests.text: The argument that the string effect is weak because PrNiO2 lacks long-range order conflicts with the sharp magnon and 3D coupling; give a quantitative mechanism.

inferred_requests.title: Justify the charge-transfer model parameters (Delta, U, JH)
inferred_requests.text: Delta = 8 eV was tuned and U = 3.2 eV is a one-band value; use literature-based parameters and revisit the Mott-Hubbard classification.

inferred_requests.title: J_perp is poorly constrained; do not claim 3D long-range order
inferred_requests.text: The gap at Gamma is hard to measure, so J_perp and the claim of 3D antiferromagnetic order are not supported; show the sensitivity and soften the claim.

inferred_requests.title: Supply the Supplementary Information, fit details and data
inferred_requests.text: The SI and the data repository were placeholders; provide fit models, constraints, low-Q fits and the data.

inferred_requests.title: Discuss epitaxial strain as a cause of the J1 difference
inferred_requests.text: The two films sit on different substrates; state the strain and its effect on J1.

inferred_requests.title: Check for charge order and sample quality
inferred_requests.text: Charge order near (1/3,0) has been reported in IL nickelates and linked to incomplete reduction; show whether this film has it.

inferred_requests.title: Clarify the origin of the 0.7 eV peak and its effect on the dxy polarization
inferred_requests.text: The 0.7 eV feature is assigned to Pr 5d without evidence and then used to explain the dxy polarization mismatch; discuss alternatives.

inferred_requests.title: Tone down claims in the abstract and conclusions
inferred_requests.text: Demonstrate, 3D order, chemically undoped, very similar to cuprates and stripe speculation go beyond the data.

inferred_requests.title: Show the robustness of the dd fits and give single-ion parameters
inferred_requests.text: The three-peak dd decomposition and the poorly defined dz2 peak need justification; list the single-ion calculation parameters.

inferred_requests.title: Justify the longer-range exchange couplings and the rare-earth role
inferred_requests.text: Explain why J3, J4 are needed and whether the rare earth drives the interlayer coupling.

inferred_requests.title: State the provenance of the CCO data
inferred_requests.text: Say whether the CCO data were published before.

inferred_requests.title: Fix the CCO resistance values and characterization
inferred_requests.text: Sheet resistance and resistivity are inconsistent.

issue_status.reason: PNO now fitted with a general NN+NNN+3rd-neighbour form and CCO with NNN-only; CCO bandwidth labels revised. No joint NN/NNN fit for CCO, and the Fig. 5 caption still says charge-transfer model fitting.
SI adds dd-fit alternatives and parameter cross-correlations, but no +H/-H comparison, model-independent moment or self-absorption discussion.
J_perp now fixed with a 0-10 meV range and SI comparison, and order becomes correlations; L is still not tabulated or varied.
Replaced by a Hund's-exchange mechanism giving t1 about 0.6 J1 in an AFM background, with a full spin-orbital derivation and a CCO estimate.
Delta, U and JH revised and sourced in Methods; no sensitivity scan, and the SI says U was effectively set from the orbital dispersion.
Damping comparison and its self-doping conclusion are unchanged; only the CCO peak is said to be resolution-limited.
J_perp fixed and the need for J3, J4 stated; quoted uncertainties, covariances and literature numbers unchanged.
No R(T), XRD or XAS of the measured film; only the indirect absence-of-charge-order check is added.
New paragraph quantifies the strain of each film and argues it opposes the J1 difference.
Single-ion parameters added in SI, 0.7 eV peak discussed with an extrinsic alternative, dz2 claim qualified; no incident-energy dependence.
Abstract and last paragraph softened, but the speculation on pairing, Tc and lack of CDWs is kept.
The proof-of-reduction sentence is kept, now backed by the absence of charge order at (1/3,0).
Stripe-order speculation removed.
SI now included and the Zenodo link given.
Fig. 2(a) still a summed spectrum; no statement on damping from individual spectra.
Phonon still quoted at about 80 meV.
Fig. 5 caption unchanged.
Fig. 4(d) label and text unchanged.
Centre of mass 2.05 eV unchanged.
Table I still says BZ edge.
Couplings still defined only in the Fig. 3 inset.
Sheet resistance replaced by a resistivity value.
YBCO comparison kept.
Angstrom spacing and duplicate Acknowledgments fixed; other typos remain.

unaddressed_major.title: Magnon damping comparison does not isolate self-doping
unaddressed_major.why: The damping paragraph and its strong conclusion are unchanged word for word apart from one clause on CCO; a referee request would usually leave at least a caveat.

unaddressed_major.title: Film characterization and reproducibility not shown
unaddressed_major.why: The authors cite their earlier paper for characterization and added an indirect sample-quality check (no charge order), which fits an answer in the letter rather than new data.
